title: Gadha Yudha
desc: Bheema and his team try to figure out the science behind black magic. Later, they learn about Mruthyu, a demon who is hiding on an island and is murdering people with his powers.

title: Mugilpete
desc: Raja and Apoorva fall head-over-heels for one another, but must overcome their families' opposing views on love. Things come to a head when Apoorva goes missing and Raja sets out to track her down.

title: Raghu Thatha
desc: A wish to fulfil her terminally ill grandfather's last desire and her stance against patriarchy sandwich Kayalvizhi Pandian, who must struggle to make the right choice.

title: Bhupathi
desc: After Bhupathi's mother and niece are attacked by the thugs of his lover's father, he decides to take revenge and turn his back on his lady.

title: Ek Love Ya
desc: After getting rejected by a girl, Amar, a law student, becomes resentful. Years into the future, he is arrested for a crime that eventually leads him to her.

title: Shakti: The Power
desc: Nandini and Shekhar's visit to India turns tragic when they meet his violent family. After losing Shekhar, Nandini fights to save their son and escape back home.
